description: This PHP source file defines a SOAP web service for the vtiger CRM system, providing methods to retrieve column details of contacts, accounts, leads, users, and support tickets, as well as session management functions.

methods.name: get_tickets_columns
methods.description: Retrieves the column names for the tickets list, verifying session and permissions.

methods.name: get_contacts_columns
methods.description: Retrieves the column names for contacts, verifying session and permissions.

methods.name: get_accounts_columns
methods.description: Retrieves the column names for accounts, verifying session and permissions.

methods.name: get_leads_columns
methods.description: Retrieves the column names for leads, verifying session and permissions.

methods.name: get_user_columns
methods.description: Retrieves the column names for users.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates an authenticated session for a user given username, password, and version.

methods.name: unsetServerSessionId
methods.description: Deletes a session ID for a user.

methods.name: validateSession
methods.description: Validates whether a session ID matches the stored session for a user.

methods.name: getServerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the current server-stored session ID for a user.
